scope_note: COMPARATOR ROW, the single most important sentence in this packet: Hanmi's own description of 'HBM TC(Thermal Compression) 본더' as its FLAGSHIP (주력 장비) product line, stated to be the core tool for producing 12- and 16-layer HBM. excerpt: 최근 메모리 업계는 하이브리드본더가 기술적 난제로 개발이 지연됨에 따라 20단 이상의 HBM 적층 시 보다 넓은 HBM칩을 적층할 수 있는 신장비의 필요성이 부각되고 있습니다. 이에 따라 Wide Die 본딩이 가능한 새로운 TC 본딩 공정의 중요성이 더욱 부각되고 있으며, 따라서 당사는 차세대 HBM 구조 변화에 선제적으로 대응하기 위해 'WIDE TC 본더' 출시를 앞두고 있습니다.

notes: W13 RECORDS REVIEW (correct) by claude_w13_records_verifier: Confirmed against hanmi_fy2025_annual p.20: "'BOC COB 본더'는...세계 최초의 투인원(Two-in-One) 본딩 장비입니다..." matches verbatim. TIER DEFECT: filed at production_claim, but on a direct side-by-side read against the sibling link hanmi_6side_inspection_hbm_yield_2025 -- registered from the same page, same present-tense '...입니다' descriptive structure, same underlying 상용화 status in the R&D table -- this one is tiered a full step stronger for no stated reason. scope_note: COMPARATOR ROW preserving a capacity-expansion figure that does not fit an existing atlas metric cleanly (see handback report): Hanmi's own 시설투자현황 (facility-investment status) disclosure states a planned investment of KRW 57,824,000,000 to build its '7th factory' (한미반도체 7공장) as a dedicated hybrid-bonder plant for 'next-generation premium HBM production', with an investment period running to 2026-11-30 (adjustable). HELD as a numeric observation rather than registered under any existing metric: the closest candidate, planned_project_rd_investment, is an R&D-investment metric by name and definition, and this is a manufacturing-capacity/construction commitment, not an R&D project, so mapping it there would misclassify the claim; no generic 'planned capital investment' metric currently exists in metrics.json, and minting one was out of scope for this intake (see AGENTS.md's guidance against minting metrics without a --metric-decisions justification). The KRW figure is preserved verbatim in this excerpt instead. Filed at 'bonding' (parent, since the factory is hybrid-bonder-dedicated and the source does not say wafer-to-wafer or die-to-wafer) and application hbm (the stated purpose is explicitly 'next-generation premium HBM production').
notes: W13 RECORDS REVIEW (correct) by claude_w13_records_verifier: Confirmed against hanmi_fy2025_annual p.24: the 시설투자현황 disclosure for '한미반도체 7공장' matches verbatim, including the investment amount, stated purpose and investment period running to 2026-11-30. TIER DEFECT: filed at production_claim, but the excerpt's own operative sentence is '...차세대 프리미엄 HBM생산에 대응할 계획입니다' -- '계획입니다' = 'it is the PLAN'. This is a disclosed FUTURE CAPEX/construction commitment for a factory not yet built (investment period not yet complete at the reporting date), not a claim that any tool is used in or qualified for production. The Foreign Incumbent Intake Brief explicitly excludes 'guidance and forecasts under an actual-flow metric' and the RECORDS PROTOCOL's production_claim calibration requires a claim of actual production use or qualification -- a planned factory is neither. Downgrading to supplier_capability (a stated purpose/plan) keeps this link truthful to its own future tense without requiring removal, since the underlying fact (a real, dated, valued investment disclosure) is genuine and worth keeping.
